parameters: "Hi there!  'Sup?  Can you tell us about this place?  Or how Benny Zinkland from school pranked us and teleported us?"
"Benny Zinkland...  Yes...  Master and divine creator...  Yes..."
"Extermination order callback routine triggered...  Presence of \P[1] Detected, verified by face and voice recognition..."
"Uhhh...  I don't like the sound of that..."
"Comment:  I do not know why my orders have been given."
"Comment:  My orders are to kill your friends, and kill your body but decapitate it and keep your head alive, preserving it
and keeping it intact as it is to become a sacred prize of the Divine Creator Benny Zinkland.  It is to be mounted on a wooden
fence outside this very dungeon, at the entrance, on the side opposite the trees."
"Um, what for?  Why mount it on the fence?  Couldn't find a pole or something?"
"Comment:  There is no reference to any 'pole' in my extermination orders, or whether or not we have one in storage or not."
"Comment:  To further answer, your head is to be mounted on the fence 'as a symbol' to future guests who come to this realm
and approach the dungeon, which is to be expanded.  It is also to be preserved and kept alive and intact, and never to be
allowed to regenerate any new neck or body, due to measures not within the scope of my orders."
"Comment:  It is acknowledged that because of \P[1]'s species, subspecies, and breed, that \P[1] is incapable of sensing
physical pain.  Other types of pain, including stress, boredom, and psychological methods are acknowledged to however
be acceptable, for the duration of \P[1]'s decapitated yet living head's *APPRECIATION*, during which time the divine
Benny Zinkland, Rex, and others may 'appreciate' \P[1]'s head's situation and psychologically torture and stress it."
"Comment:  According to my extermination orders, \P[1]'s head has no ending date for being appreciated as said."
"Comment:  The orders include a complete eternal care plan for \P[1]'s living head, which includes enduring food
and diet including dog poop while mounted on the fence, being urinated on, and taunted and teased, among other
concepts, with unspecified unlimited room for expanded options.  'Bully Bait' is a referenced term."
"Okay I get it - Benny Zinkland's in love with me."
"So what kind of robot are you?  Are you programmed to be a classic bad guy boss who gives away the whole plot of the movie?
"I'm explaining because you asked me, doof."
Though you were caught off-guard by the abrupt change in the way the robot was talking to you, you quickly get over it and
"If that's what you're orders are, then you'll just have to kill my body and kill my friends too, before we destroy you!"
"I just thought it over.  Using logic, I will comply with your conditions.  You insist that I attempt to take a course
of action if my orders are a certain way, and they are, parsed, processed and interpreted, and verified.  I will therefore
attempt to cooperate with the conditions you demand I accept and now attempt once again to give you what you ask for.
In conclusion, I shall carry out the extermination orders, as you insist I must do.  Thank you, have a nice day."
